postpartum_topics.title: Physical recovery
postpartum_topics.content: Recovery after birth takes 6-8 weeks. Lochia (vaginal discharge) can last 4-6 weeks. See a doctor if you have fever, intense pain, or foul-smelling discharge.

postpartum_topics.title: Emotional health
postpartum_topics.content: "Baby blues" (sadness, crying, irritability in the first 2 weeks) is normal. If symptoms persist or are severe, it could be postpartum depression — seek help.

postpartum_topics.title: Breastfeeding
postpartum_topics.content: Colostrum in the first days is essential. Breastfeeding on demand (8-12 times/day) stimulates milk production. Seek a lactation consultant if problems arise.

postpartum_topics.title: Postpartum checkups
postpartum_topics.content: Mandatory checkup at 6 weeks. Additional checkups at 2 weeks if you had complications. Whooping cough vaccine recommended if you didn't get it during pregnancy.

postpartum_topics.title: Sleep and rest
postpartum_topics.content: "Sleep when the baby sleeps." Sleep deprivation is real — take turns with your partner. Avoid bringing the baby into your bed (SIDS risk).

MamiApp account email:
Name, if applicable:

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.hero_subtitle: MamiApp is built with privacy as a core principle. Full GDPR alignment and clear transparency for our users.
privacy_page.footer_note: This policy follows Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Romanian personal data protection law.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: The personal data controller is MamiApp (example.com). You can contact us at contact@example.com for questions about personal data or GDPR rights.

sections.title: 2. Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect account, profile, pregnancy, child, family, community, AI conversation, notification, technical usage and subscription data.

sections.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis
sections.body: We process data to provide the service, secure accounts, send notifications, operate AI features, enable family sharing, improve the app and meet legal obligations. For push notifications, we record whether they were opened, based on our legitimate interest in optimizing their frequency and relevance and reducing unwanted notifications.

sections.title: 4. Data Recipients
sections.body: We use third-party services such as Google Firebase, Anthropic, Expo and payment providers. MamiApp does not sell or rent user data.

sections.title: 5. International Transfers
sections.body: Some services may process data outside the EEA, including in the United States, protected through GDPR safeguards.

sections.title: 6. Retention Period
sections.body: Data is kept while the account is active and removed after account deletion according to the retention policy.

sections.title: 7. Your GDPR Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, restrict, port and object to processing.

sections.title: 8. Right to Complain
sections.body: You may file a complaint with ANSPDCP: dataprotection.ro.

sections.title: 9. Data Security
sections.body: We use encryption, Firebase Security Rules, limited data access and monitoring. AI keys are never stored on the device.

sections.title: 10. Cookies and Local Data
sections.body: The app uses local storage, IndexedDB and Service Worker cache for authentication, performance and offline use.

sections.title: 11. Childrens Data
sections.body: MamiApp is intended for adults. Child data is entered by a parent or legal guardian.

sections.title: 12. Policy Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy for legal, technical or operational changes.

sections.title: 9. Family Sharing

sections.title: 12. Account Deletion
sections.content: Users may request account deletion from the app or by email. Deletion may result in loss of data and service access according to the retention policy.
